units: Ḥull. 60ᵃ; Sabb. 28ᵇ; Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ שור שהקריב … מ׳ מפריס the ox which Adam offered had one horn in his forehead, for it is written (Ps. LXIX, 32) &c.; מ׳ תרין משמע but does not maḳrin mean ‘having two horns’ (as מפריס ‘having hoofs’)? מקרן כתיב it is written without Yod (intimating a defect).
